buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the

original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Submission of Product Samples: The tenderer shall submit physical samples of the products strictly in accordanc e with the specifications prescribed in the tender document, on or before the bi d submission end date. Failure to submit the required samples within the stipulated time shall result in disqualification of the tenderer. The samples sub mitted shall be thoroughly scrutinised and verified against the prescribed specif ications. In the event of any discrepancy, deviation, mismatch or non-complianc e between the submitted samples and the prescribed specifications, the tender shall be liable for rejection. 2. Financial Documents: The tenderer shall submit the following financial documents: Turnover Certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant. Net Worth Certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant. 3. Income Tax Returns: The tenderer shall submit copies of Income Tax Returns (ITR) filed for the last th ree financial years, namely 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26. Copies of the respe ctive filed returns shall be uploaded along with the tender bid. 4. GST Registration and Returns: The tenderer shall possess a valid GST Registration Certificate relevant to the n ature of the business. A copy of the GST Registration Certificate and proof of GS T returns filed for the financial years 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26 shall be u ploaded along with the bid. 5. Supply of Products: The successful bidder (L1) shall be responsible for supplying the products to var ious hostels located in the Puducherry and Karaikal regions. The list of hostels, along with their respective addresses and delivery locations, will be furnished at the time of issuance of the Work Order/Supply Order. The bidder shall ensure ti mely delivery at all designated locations. Upon delivery, the materials supplied shall be thoroughly inspected and verified by the concerned authorities to ensure that their quality, quantity and specifications conform to the approved samples and the requirements prescribe d in the tender document. If any discrepancy, deviation, mismatch, inferior quality or non-compliance with the approved samples or prescr ibed specifications is noticed during inspection, the supplied materials shall be liable for rejection, and the successful bidder shall replace the rejected materials with conforming materials at no additional cost to t he Department. The decision of the competent authority regarding the quality and conformity of the supplied materials shall be final.

6. Local Office and Complaint Redressal: The tenderer shall have an office or authorised service facility in the consignee's location to ensure prompt service and after-sales support. In the ev ent of any complaint or service-related issue, the tenderer shall attend to and v erify the complaint within 2 to 3 hours from the time of receipt of the complain t. 7. Firm Registration Certificate: The tenderer shall upload a valid registration certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies / Registrar of Co-operative Societies / Registrar of Firms, as applic able. In the case of a proprietorship firm, a valid GST Registration Certificate obt ained in the name of the bidding establishment may be submitted in lieu of the Firm Registration Certificate. 8. Declaration Regarding Blacklisting: The tenderer shall submit a self-declaration on the firm's letterhead, duly signed by the authorised signatory, stating that the bidder or its associated firm has not been blacklisted, debarred or suspended from participating in or undert aking supply contracts by any Government Department, Government Institution or Public Sector Undertaking during the last three financial years. 9. PAN and TAN Registration: The tenderer shall possess valid PAN and TAN registrations, wherever applicable, and upload copies of the respective certificates/cards along with the bid. 10. Refund of EMD to Unsuccessful Tenderers: The Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) submitted by unsuccessful tenderers shall be refunded immediately after the opening of the financial bid, subject to applicabl e rules and procedures. 11. Submission of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The prescribed Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall be submitted in favour of "T he Director, Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Puducherry" on or before the stipulated bid submission end date and time. Failure to submit the EMD in t he prescribed manner within the stipulated time shall render the tender liable fo r rejection. 12. Right of the Competent Authority: The Director, Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department, P uducherry, reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders, including th e samples submitted, either wholly or partly, without assigning any reason ther eof. The decision of the competent authority shall be final, subject to the applic able tender rules and conditions. . 3. Certificates

ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.
